app.name: Loan Tracker
app.offline: You are offline. You can read what you last opened; saving needs a connection.
app.offlineSave: Saving needs a connection. Nothing was saved — try again when you are online.

auth.totpHint: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code.
auth.setupIntro: Create your owner account. Only you can open this app.
auth.name: Your name
auth.passwordRule: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
auth.stepUpIntro: Type your password again to continue.

method.reducing_hint: Same installment every time; interest on what is still owed.
method.flat_hint: Same interest every time, on the full amount lent.
method.interest_only_hint: Pay interest each time; the full amount at the end.
method.simple_days_hint: One payment at the end; interest for the number of days.
method.custom: Principal and interest set per installment

home.title: Today
home.byMode: Split by cash, UPI and bank
home.setStart: Set your starting cash in Settings to see the balance.
home.nothingIn: No money in on this day.
home.nothingOut: No money out on this day.

dues.emptyUpcoming: Nothing due in the coming days.

borrower.nameRule: One name is enough; both can be searched.
borrower.aadhaarHint: 12 digits. Stored encrypted and shown masked.
borrower.aadhaarKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved number
borrower.consentNotice: I explained to the borrower why their details are collected and kept, and they agreed.
borrower.duplicateTitle: This person may already be here
borrower.duplicateAadhaar: The same Aadhaar number belongs to {{codes}}.
borrower.duplicatePhone: The same phone number belongs to {{codes}}.
borrower.duplicateOwnerOnly: Only the owner can save a duplicate.
borrower.noConsent: No consent recorded yet. Record it before giving a loan.
borrower.incomplete: Aadhaar is missing. Add it before giving a new loan.
borrower.empty: No borrowers yet. Add the first one.
borrower.eraseConfirm: Erase this borrower's personal details? Loan records are kept as the law requires.
borrower.deleteConfirm: Delete this borrower? This is only possible if they never had a loan.

consentText.en: We record your name, phone, address, Aadhaar number and documents only to give and manage your loan and to contact you about payments. They are stored securely on the lender's own computer, are not shared, and are kept for {{years}} years after your loan closes. You can ask to see, correct or remove your details.
consentText.ta: உங்கள் பெயர், போன் எண், முகவரி, ஆதார் எண் மற்றும் ஆவணங்களை உங்கள் கடனைக் கொடுக்கவும் கவனிக்கவும், தவணை பற்றி உங்களைத் தொடர்பு கொள்ளவும் மட்டுமே பதிவு செய்கிறோம். இவை கடன் கொடுப்பவரின் சொந்தக் கணினியில் பாதுகாப்பாக வைக்கப்படும், யாருடனும் பகிரப்படாது. கடன் முடிந்த பின் {{years}} ஆண்டுகள் வைக்கப்படும். உங்கள் விவரங்களைப் பார்க்க, திருத்த அல்லது நீக்கக் கேட்கலாம்.

loan.pastHint: An older loan from the notebook? Put the real date; you can then enter its old payments.
loan.fixedToggle: Borrower wants a fixed amount every {{period}}
loan.fixedToggleHint: Turn on when the borrower says how much they can pay each time.
loan.fixedFromPeriodHint: Pick how long. The app works out the fixed amount.
loan.fixedFromAmountHint: Enter what they will pay. The app works out how long it takes.
loan.fixedSplitHint: Enter the interest and the principal for each {{period}}.
loan.customInterestHint: Leave empty to use the interest rate.
loan.rowsMismatch: Principal parts add up to {{actual}}; they must add up to {{expected}} ({{difference}} left).
loan.penaltyPct: % per month on the overdue amount
loan.rateWarning: This is about {{rate}}% a month, above your maximum of {{max}}%.
loan.settleIntro: Outstanding principal plus interest up to the chosen date. Later interest is not charged.
loan.writeOffIntro: Use this when the money will not come back, or to accept less and close the loan.
loan.deleteConfirm: Delete this loan? Only possible when no payment was recorded.

payment.title: Record payment
payment.reverseIntro: The payment stays in the records with a reversal entry, and the installments open again.
payment.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future.

cash.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? The change is kept in the history.

doc.title: Documents
doc.ownerOnly: Only the owner can open this file.
doc.deleteConfirm: Delete this file? It can be recovered for 30 days.
doc.rules: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC, up to {{mb}} MB each.

settings.title: Settings
settings.maxRateHint: Set from the current notification; you will be warned before saving a loan above it.
settings.openingBalance: Cash in hand on that date
settings.twoFactorScan: Scan this with your authenticator app, then type the code it shows.
settings.retention: Keep borrower data after the loan closes (years)

import.title: Notebook import
import.intro: Bring loans from the notebook in one go. Download the template, fill one row per loan, add old payments on the second sheet, then upload it here.
import.totals: Totals — compare these with the notebook
import.missingAadhaar: {{count}} borrowers have no Aadhaar yet; add it later.
